Dockerfile has no USER and Compose no memory/CPU hard limits or read_only root. Run an explicit nonroot UID, constrain resources, use read-only config/assets/models where appropriate, and segment backend from untrusted peer containers. No container escape or public reachability was established.

Add .dockerignore for live secrets/data/logs/git/tasks before any remote builder use; explicit COPY currently avoids proving these enter final image. config.yaml itself is not gitignored though application config can contain comms/API credentials; prefer environment/external secret custody and explicit ignore policy.
